scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently applied for a housing loan. Could you please tell me the status of my application? Also, what is the interest rate I've been offered?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a housing loan has been denied. The record does not include an interest rate because the loan was not approved.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you tell me the reason for the denial? Also, what type of loan product was I considered for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was denied primarily due to a debt-to-income ratio above 60%. You were considered for a conventional first lien loan for a home purchase.

dialogue.user: I understand. Is there any additional information you can provide about what my debt-to-income ratio means in this context? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is the ratio of your monthly debt payments to your monthly income. This field is not applicable because the loan was denied.

dialogue.user: I see. Thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know. <Neutral>. The agent provided the necessary details about the denial, but I would have appreciated more context about the debt-to-income ratio.
